title: Horizontal comparison homotopy for Cartan--Eilenberg rows
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Let $K^\bullet$ and $L^\bullet$ be cochain complexes in $\mathcal A$, let $I^{p,q}$ and $J^{p,q}$ be first-quadrant double complexes with augmentations $\epsilon_I:K^\bullet\to I^{\bullet,0}$ and $\epsilon_J:L^\bullet\to J^{\bullet,0}$, and let $\delta:I\to J$ be a morphism of double complexes. Assume that the augmented boundary, cycle, and horizontal-cohomology rows of $I$ are exact, that the corresponding rows of $J$ are injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and that a cochain map $w:K^\bullet\to L^\bullet$ has a homotopy $s^p:K^p\to L^{p-1}$ with $w^p=d_L^{p-1}s^p+s^{p+1}d_K^p$ and $\delta^{p,0}\epsilon_I^p=\epsilon_J^p w^p$. Then there are maps $s_1^{p,q}:I^{p,q}\to J^{p-1,q}$, with $s_1^{p,0}\epsilon_I^p=\epsilon_J^{p-1}s^p$, such that each $s_1^{p,\bullet}$ is a map of column complexes (so $d_v s_1=s_1d_v$), and $R=\delta-d_hs_1-s_1d_h$ is a morphism of vertical complexes that vanishes on the augmented horizontal row.
